arm_interactions.definition: These legacy-named sets compare B fresh fusion scores with C's historical HTTP Qwen reference, while C reranker deltas are paired within C. Capture/candidate surfaces and timeline evidence differ. No matched B/C intervention or fusion-to-reranker pipeline was tested.

capability_warning: Overlapping query-side labels describe requirements; they do not diagnose visual/OCR/ASR causes.

comparison_scope.cross_packet: Descriptive query-level comparison across different captures and candidate surfaces. Neither candidate identity nor collection conditions are held fixed between B and C.
comparison_scope.frozen_evidence: The pinned range/event scorer is shared. C frozen scores retain original HTTP timeline evidence; B supplies frame-only candidates. Comparable score labels do not establish identical evidence.
comparison_scope.packet_b_baseline: Fresh raw-provider Qwen candidates from the same collection identity as B's five fusion transforms; stored as qwen_only_matched.
comparison_scope.packet_c_baseline: Historical saved Qwen HTTP candidates in inputs/qwen_only_top100.jsonl; paired with C's saved reranker output.
comparison_scope.pipeline: No fusion-to-reranker pipeline or causal interaction was tested.
comparison_scope.runtime: Historical C rank evidence does not certify a fresh model loader or corpus extraction lineage. A defect in a later runtime cannot be transferred to C without run-bound evidence.

cross_run_qwen_baseline_differences.scope: Differences can reflect collection, candidate surface and timeline evidence; they do not isolate model or ranking changes.

fusion.matched_qwen_verification: All113 raw-Qwen controls independently rescored in three top20 layers and retained100 diagnostics.
fusion.rank_comparison_boundary: B/C candidate surfaces, captures and timeline evidence differ; cross-packet comparisons are descriptive.
fusion.selection_qualification: Exploratory development selection after comparing five global arms; no per-query oracle or held-out superiority claim.
fusion.selection_rule: Verify B global distinct-video R20, then MRR20, then R1, then fixed FUSION_ARMS order; frozen range/event performance remains separate.

matched_b_contrasts.scope: B transforms and raw Qwen share one fresh provider collection. These are within-B contrasts; C's saved reranker is not part of this matched experiment. Global selection remains exploratory.

mechanism_limit: Saved evidence establishes pool absence and score movement; extraction, calibration, representation and temporal reasoning causes require further evidence.
primary_failure_scope: Remaining misses after the descriptive success union are classified against observed C historical top100 plus fresh B active-provider union/current100. Missing-video/event labels describe absence from those saved pools only. Existing target evidence leaves ranking unresolved. Baseline failure and candidate ceiling remain historical-C-only; no extraction or corpus-wide absence cause is inferred.

runtime_provenance.scope: Provenance snapshot; a current-runtime defect concerns the inspected attempt, not every future B run.

synthesis_policy.current_repair_scope: The identified repaired constructor/checkpoint passed exact equality; historicalC state and corpus lineage remain unverified.
synthesis_policy.new_runtime_performance_claim: Requires verified loader and declared corpus compatibility
synthesis_policy.next_smallest_provenance_step: Recover existing extraction/index-generation claims; check selected feature byte hashes and run-bound loader/checkpoint state. If missing, record unknown and use a bounded compatibility probe.

dense.causal_limit: Independent retained-top100 visibility evidence only. Repeated text, target absence and sparse/dense differences do not establish extraction, compatible-index or historical Qwen/reranker causes. These observations do not change the ledger's primary failure or observed-arm success union.

index_generation_identity.interpretation: Collection schema/index metadata are pinned; historical stored-vector encoder/index generation remains unresolved unless the existing index registry provides an actual generation chain. Target absence is only absence from this dense field's retained100 under the declared current encoder.

checkpoint_parameter_audit.unused_pooler_exclusion: Exact main embedding reads last_hidden_state[:,0] and never pooler_output; pooler parameters do not affect this output.

model_identity.initialization_scope: Same effective PyTorch CPU/float32 tokenizer/model settings as main, with local-files-only and loading-state audit; exact main encoding methods are executed.

sparse.causal_limit: Independent retained-top100 visibility evidence only. Repeated text, target absence and sparse/dense differences do not establish extraction, compatible-index or historical Qwen/reranker causes. These observations do not change the ledger's primary failure or observed-arm success union.

source_visibility.scope: Independent frozen38 query/channel evidence overlays; no benchmark score, causal failure label or observed-arm union is changed.

taxonomy_extension: none explicitly represents success; missing_event includes missing accepted ranges for non-TRAKE queries.

temporal.interpretation: At least one required event remains missing; this does not imply every event is absent or prove a representation failure.

truth.explanation: 41 queries use P3 provisional text or historical event proxies. Source review does not by itself establish truth quality as the dominant retrieval-miss cause.

source_review.scope: Proposal overlay only; representative points do not certify first occurrence, completion or the full sequence.
